nodes.label: Lean Codebase Rule
nodes.rationale: Deliver working, maintainable application with minimum necessary code. Prefer simplicity over architectural purity.

nodes.label: Component Creation Rules
nodes.rationale: Create a new component only if: reused in 3+ places, or file > 250-300 lines, or distinct UI element with independent responsibility.

nodes.label: Custom Hook Rules
nodes.rationale: Do not create custom hooks unless same stateful logic is reused in 3+ places. Keep logic local until reuse is proven.

nodes.label: Utility Creation Rules
nodes.rationale: Do not create generic utils without demonstrated reuse. Utility functions should exist only when shared across multiple features.

nodes.label: State Management Principles
nodes.rationale: Prefer local component state. Lift state only when necessary. Introduce Context/global state only when multiple unrelated components require the same mutable data.

nodes.label: Styling Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Prefer Tailwind utility classes directly in components. Avoid creating styling wrapper components unless they provide meaningful reusable behavior.

nodes.label: Dependency Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Determine whether functionality can be implemented cleanly with existing dependencies or a small amount of code. Do not introduce libraries for trivial functionality.

nodes.label: Refactoring Rules
nodes.rationale: Remove dead code, duplicate code, unnecessary abstractions, merge tiny components, delete unused files/imports/variables, and reduce complexity.

nodes.label: Similar Issues Automatic Check
nodes.rationale: Check for similar issues automatically before submission to reduce duplicate reports.

nodes.label: Impact Scope Selector
nodes.rationale: Estimate scale of people affected (Just me, family, neighborhood, locality, ward, city, district, state, nationwide) to gauge civic severity.

nodes.label: Issue Priority/Impact Options
nodes.rationale: Classify potential damage (minor, health, safety, environment, traffic, financial, public service) if the issue is not fixed.

nodes.label: Location Fields
nodes.rationale: Capture physical address, ZIP code, and GPS coordinates to precisely locate the reported civic issue.

nodes.label: Ponytail Rule
nodes.rationale: Lazy senior developer mode. Emphasizes efficiency over carelessness, writing minimum code, and verifying understanding before implementing.

nodes.label: Ponytail Decision Ladder
nodes.rationale: A sequence of questions to ask before writing code: YAGNI, reuse codebase patterns/utils, standard library, native platform, installed dependency, one-liner, and then minimum code.

nodes.label: Ponytail Bug Fixing Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Bug fixes should target the root cause, not just symptoms. Grep all callers of a function and fix the shared function once rather than patching each path individually.

nodes.label: Ponytail Comments for Deliberate Simplification
nodes.rationale: Marking deliberate simplifications that cut corners with a comment naming the ceiling and upgrade path.

nodes.label: Ponytail Testing Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Leave ONE runnable check behind for non-trivial logic (an assert-based demo or self-check, no frameworks or fixtures). Trivial one-liners need no test.
